description: Read the records of a finished Evascrape job as structured data. Returns the field names and the rows, paged. Ask for a job that has already reached the status "succeeded". With email verification enabled you can pick a variant: "good" for deliverable addresses only, "risk" for catch-all, "bad" for undeliverable. Default "all".

limit.description: How many records to return. Default 1000, maximum 10000.

offset.description: Skip this many records, for paging. Default 0.

name: download
title: Download the records of a finished job
